decision.comment: Profiling stage is clean and internally consistent. PathMNIST (9-class, 28×28 RGB) loads with split sizes exactly matching the official MedMNIST distribution (train 89996 / val 10004 / test 7180); no subsampling, no blank images, no duplicate train samples. Archive MD5 is verified against the manifest. Class imbalance is modest (ratio 1.63) and train/val class proportions are nearly identical (max absolute deviation < 0.0001), indicating no split-level distribution shift. The ambiguity-risk list is appropriate for 28×28 histology patches and correctly notes that patch-level multi-tissue overlap and low-resolution texture loss are the primary confounders. The test-domain note (CRC-VAL-HE-7K from a different clinical center) is properly flagged as an OOD consideration for downstream evaluation. Run manifest records code SHA-256, seed 42, deterministic torch, and pinned package versions. One non-deterministic reproducibility note: llm_model_digest is null for qwen3.8 (Ollama), meaning exact model weights are not pinned; this is a warning-level concern for full reproducibility but does not block the pipeline. No deterministic findings are present, so no stop or revise action is warranted. Proceed to the next stage.
